name: LINE
author: Frank Yang
description: Unread LINE messages in the bar, read from a local daemon's state file.

barWidget.description: One bar icon with the unread count, and a panel listing the chats waiting on you.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: Panel language. System follows your OS locale (zh* → 繁體中文, anything else → English). Pick 繁體中文 to keep Chinese on an English system.

schema.label: Panel position
schema.description: Where the LINE panel opens. Center of screen puts it in the middle of the monitor instead of hanging off the bar icon. App window opens it as a normal Hyprland window (class org.quickshell, title LINE) that tiles, alt-tabs and keeps external viewers on top.

schema.label: App window width (px)
schema.description: Remembered size of the App window placement. Updated automatically when you resize the window.

schema.label: App window height (px)
schema.description: Remembered size of the App window placement. Updated automatically when you resize the window.

schema.label: Text size (%)
schema.description: Scales the text inside the LINE panel. The bar icon follows your bar settings.

schema.label: Scroll speed (%)
schema.description: How far one wheel notch scrolls the chat list, the conversation and the sticker grid. 100 is the default feel; the button in the panel steps through 50, 75, 100, 150, 200 and 300.

schema.label: Messages per page
schema.description: How many messages are fetched when a chat opens and each time the conversation pages back. The button in the panel steps through 30, 60, 100 and 150. A bigger page means fewer round trips while reading back, at the cost of a slower first paint.
